privacy_notice: All camera processing and recognition is performed locally. No camera frames, microphone recordings or conversations are uploaded to a cloud service.

support_levels.supported: Static hand shapes that a trained model can recognise from a single frame: ASL letters A-I, K-Y (all except J and Z) and numbers 0-9. Accuracy depends on the dataset you train with.
support_levels.experimental: Motion letters J and Z (need the 'Experimental dynamic gestures' setting), and the starter WORD list, which are simplified static poses defined by this project - NOT the real ASL signs, which use movement, two hands and facial expression.
support_levels.unsupported: Everything else: full ASL sentences, ASL grammar, facial expressions, fingerspelling speed, other sign languages, and any sign not listed in the Help Center.

sections.title: How to Use Camera
body: The camera is OFF when the app opens, to protect your privacy.
1. Press START CAMERA (or the C key). The live preview appears at the top-left.
2. Check the three status lights under the preview: Camera, Hand and Recognition.
3. Choose a mode on the right: ALPHABET, NUMBERS, WORDS or AUTO.
4. Show a gesture and hold it steady. A progress bar fills while the app makes sure the gesture is stable.
5. When the bar is full, the gesture is added to your sentence. Change or lower your hand before repeating the same gesture.
Use PAUSE DETECTION if you need to move your hand without adding anything.
The preview is a mirror image, like a selfie camera, so it feels natural.

sections.title: How to Position Hand
body: • Sit about an arm's length (40-70 cm) from the camera.
• Keep your whole hand and wrist inside the picture, with some space around it.
• Use a plain, uncluttered background if possible.
• Face a light source (window or lamp). Avoid a bright light behind you.
• Hold the gesture still, palm toward the camera unless the instructions say otherwise.
• Wear sleeves that contrast with your skin so the wrist is easy to see.
• For two-hand gestures keep both hands in view and not overlapping.

sections.title: Voice Mode
body: Voice Mode lets the other person speak and shows their words as text.
1. Press VOICE MODE (or V). The microphone light turns on when listening starts.
2. The other person speaks normally. Their words appear under PERSON B - VOICE and in the history.
3. Turn on 'Read voice text aloud' in Settings if you want the text spoken as well.
Speech recognition is done by Vosk, a free offline engine. It needs a small language model folder inside the models folder (see Setup & Demo Mode).
If the model or microphone is missing, the app keeps working: Person B can simply type in the box and press SEND.

sections.title: Sentence Builder
body: Accepted gestures are collected and turned into a sentence for you.
• Words such as I + NEED + WATER become "I need water."
• Letters are collected into a spelled word. SPACE finishes the word.
• A + L + I  =  ALI. Press USE AS NAME and you get "My name is Ali."
• Type your name in the Name box and press MY NAME to insert "My name is <your name>."
• DELETE removes the last letter or word. CLEAR (R) removes everything.
• CAPITALIZE forces a capital letter on the last word.
• ADD WORD lets you type any word (useful for words with no gesture yet).
• Questions (Where..., What..., Do...) automatically get a question mark.

sections.title: Setup & Demo Mode
body: Demo Mode starts automatically when no trained model exists in the models folder.

In Demo Mode the app uses a simple finger-counting rule (which fingers are open) for a small set of poses. These are labelled "Demo prediction". It is NOT real ASL recognition and has no accuracy score.
To get real recognition:
1. Download a free ASL dataset (see the README or run: python setup_dataset.py).
2. Put it in dataset/raw/ .
3. Run train_model.bat (or: python training/prepare_dataset.py, then extract_features.py, then train_model.py).
4. Restart the app. The 'Demo Mode' banner disappears once models are found.
Press RUN DEMO on the dashboard to watch a full example without a camera.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
body: Camera does not start: close other apps that use the camera (Zoom, Teams), then try another camera number in Settings.
"No hand detected": move your hand into view, improve the lighting, or lower 'Detection confidence' in Settings.
"Gesture unclear": hold the pose more steadily, or move slightly closer. You can lower 'Recognition confidence' a little.
Letters repeat or are missed: adjust 'Gesture stabilization time' in Settings.
No sound: check the Windows volume, then choose another voice in Settings and press Test voice.
Voice Mode unavailable: make sure a Vosk model folder is inside models/ and a microphone is connected. Person B can still type.
App is slow: choose 320x240 or 640x480, and raise 'Process every N frames' in Settings.
Demo Mode will not go away: models must be inside the models folder with the exact file names listed in the README.
Still stuck? Use OFFLINE HELP for a plain text guide that works even if pictures fail to load.

sections.title: Privacy
body: All camera processing and recognition is performed locally. No camera frames, microphone recordings or conversations are uploaded to a cloud service.
• The camera is off until you start it.
• No video or audio is saved to disk.
• Conversation history is stored only in config/history.json on this computer. Press CLEAR HISTORY to delete it, or turn off 'Save history' in Settings.
• The app never asks for an account, key or credit card.
